description_en: Retrieves the temporary authentication information for a specified DSW instance
description_zh: 获取指定DSW实例的临时鉴权信息
name: GetToken

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. For information about how to obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the issued token. Valid values:

Access: used to access the DSW instance and perform operations. This type grants operation permissions.
View: used to share DSW instance information (such as status, configurations, and logs) in read-only mode. This type does not grant modification or control permissions and is suitable for collaborators or external viewers
parameters.help_zh:
签发的token类型
Access : 用于进入DSW实例内部执行操作。具备操作权限。
View：用于只读分享 DSW 实例信息（如状态、配置、日志等），不具备修改或控制权限，适用于协作者或外部查看者
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The intended holder (consumer) of the token. If you access the DSW page through a self-built web application, set Audience to ThirdParty
parameters.help_zh:
Audience 用于指定 Token 的预期持有者（即使用方）。
当您通过自建 Web 应用接入 DSW页面 时，请将 audience 设置为 ThirdParty
parameters.name: audience

Code.description_en:
The status code. Valid values:
InternalError: an internal error occurred. Errors other than parameter validation errors are classified as internal errors.
ValidationError: a parameter validation error occurred
Code.description_zh:
状态码，可能值：
InternalError：内部错误（除了参数验证错误外的其他错误，目前都归类到内部错误）。
ValidationError：参数验证错误

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true
false
Success.description_zh:
成功标志，可能值：
true
false

Token.description_en: The temporary authentication information for accessing the DSW instance
Token.description_zh: 访问DSW实例的临时鉴权信息
